protocol: Controlled 27,500-step (25,000 Stage-1 + 2,500 Stage-2 5.0s LMFT, global batch 512, seed 42) multi-domain TPU v6p ablation isolating Nesterov SGD vs. AdamW and 2-block Conformer temporal mixer vs. pure 2D SimAM-ERes2Net.

eres2conformer_catp_sgd.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer (2 Conformer blocks) + Context-ATP + Sub-Center ArcFace (K=3) + Nesterov SGD (lr=0.18)

eres2conformer_catp_adamw.description: SimAM-ERes2Conformer (2 Conformer blocks) + Context-ATP + Sub-Center ArcFace (K=3) + AdamW (lr=1.2e-3)

eres2net_noconf_catp_sgd.description: SimAM-ERes2Net-NoConformer (0 Conformer blocks) + Context-ATP + Sub-Center ArcFace (K=3) + Nesterov SGD (lr=0.18)
